title: I Took Revenge On My Neighbor Gary #shorts

lines.text: My neighbor parked in my spot every single day, so I left him a polite note.
Parking is first come, first served. Love, Gary.
So I took revenge. Day one, I parked sideways and blocked him in.
He honked at six AM. I waved like an angel.
Day two, I covered his entire car in sticky notes.
Day three, I put a traffic cone on his roof. That's when someone knocked on my door.
Are you the one blocking my son? He works night shifts to pay for my treatment. He parks close because he's exhausted.
I froze. I felt like the worst person on Earth.
The next morning, I left a new note: The spot is yours. Coffee is on me.
An hour later, Gary knocked on my door, holding a pizza.
We're best friends now. He still takes my parking spot. But he brings pizza.

sources: Original fictional story written for this channel

facts.hedge: fictional story, not a real event
